classes.p_miss: offline J_P judge level F_hat < F_min over U/L episodes (203.1) with t_on >= event start and without crawler_transient: miss / detect / none
classes.item6: min over legs of the 1 ms rod-axis force (C-S8-2) on [event start, end] >= F_min: pass / fail
classes.reapproach: any leg_reapproach_start with t >= event start: yes / no; if_lift = expected yes when an L episode >= lift_min_s exists after the event start, else not compared
